memory.attribution: Host process capture window only; overlaps can contain several phases/player counts. No FPS, network, per-phase memory, or client-B process inference.

limitations: Only MHQA_LONG_1 rows are accepted. Usernames, absolute paths, IPs and unrelated raw log text are never copied.
100 engine ticks is nominally five seconds at 20 TPS, and can take longer under stalls. Threshold transitions are bounded by observations, not timed exactly.
No interpolation across missing/invalid samples or sequence reset. Separate sessions may represent reloads; their cumulative metrics are not a continuous run.
State-specific TPS excludes transition intervals; overall/per-match summaries include pause and connection transitions.
Engine tick/wall-clock ratio is not FPS. Wall-clock adjustments and logging overhead remain possible.
Not observing an event in a partial/buffered log is not proof that it did not occur.
Analysis completion is separate from game-match end, capture closure, or Stable QA completion.
